text:
customer-jackson: Hi, getting 403 Invalid API key on embeddings endpoint after migrating keys. curl below, same key works for completions but fails for embeddings. Help?

customer-jackson: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"Invalid API key"}
```

support-jamie: thanks — can you paste the full response body and the account id you used (or PM it)?
support-jamie: also which plan is the account on? :thinking:

customer-jackson: account id 54321, plan header on our app shows "standard" (we migrated from trial). I pasted full body — that's the only error we get. call id: c-9a1b

support-jamie: got it. one quick check: can you try the same request to /v1/completions with same key? you said completions work, double-checking same key + timestamp?

customer-jackson: completions still OK. embeddings returns 403 consistently. We downgraded to a minimal repro: same key, different endpoint => different result.

eng-ryan: tagging in eng — from logs I can see the API returned 403 with internal_code=ENTITLEMENT_MISSING but the proxy translated body to "Invalid API key" for privacy. Let me pull the exact log lines.

eng-ryan: logs snippet: ```[2026-03-17T15:02:13Z] request id=c-9a1b route=/v1/embeddings user=acct:54321 auth=sk_live_abc123 result=403 reason=ENTITLEMENT_MISSING detail="feature:embeddings not in plan:standard"
[2026-03-17T15:02:13Z] proxy mask applied: response.body="Invalid API key"
```

customer-jackson: wait so it's a plan/feature block, not an auth failure? why does UI show invalid key? customers assume key is broken.

support-jamie: that's the problem — we intentionally mask entitlement messages to avoid leaking feature inventory, but it seems our global mask is too generic and is causing support friction.

billing-lina: quick note from billing: acct 54321 was moved off trial two weeks ago to "standard" which does not include embeddings. Upgrade to "pro" or enable embeddings add-on should resolve immediately.

se-ashley: workaround for the customer while we fix messaging: either call the compatible model endpoint (completions) or temporarily enable embeddings on their tenant from billing console. I've added a one-click toggle in the billing ticket.

eng-ryan: action items: 1) change proxy mask mapping so ENTITLEMENT_MISSING surfaces a distinct message like "Feature not enabled for plan" (still 403). 2) add telemetry tag so support can programmatically distinguish auth vs entitlement in logs without exposing policy. 3) hotfix to apply on prod today.

support-jamie: customer, would you like billing to enable embeddings for a 24h test while we deploy the clearer error text? :eyes:

customer-jackson: yes please — that'd be great, thanks.

billing-lina: done — enabled embeddings for acct 54321 for 24h. please verify.

customer-jackson: verified — embeddings now works, 200 OK. thanks.

eng-ryan: rolling a small change: map ENTITLEMENT_MISSING -> {code:ENTITLEMENT_MISSING, message:"Feature not enabled for plan. Contact billing or upgrade your plan."} and keep 403. will push within the hour, then update docs.

support-jamie: created support KB draft: "403 shown as Invalid API key may be entitlement gating; check internal_code ENTITLEMENT_MISSING and account plan" — brief, will link to billing steps.

sso-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-17-emb-gate-mask, severity=low, assignees=eng-ryan,billing-lina,support-jamie

eng-ryan: after deploy I'll post the exact change diff and the new example responses. closing loop here once prod verifies.

support-jamie: marking customer ticket resolved pending follow-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:
